verdict.rationale: ADK explicitly supports event-driven automation via Callbacks ("Hook into specific events during an agent's execution lifecycle... without altering core agent logic") and a Workflow Runtime graph engine with routing, retry, fan-out/fan-in and dynamic nodes for triggering actions on execution events, matching the story of defining rules that fire on events. missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of callback-triggered rules in production use, and more detail on condition-based rule syntax beyond docs summaries.
